# Fitbit Air — Complete Technical & Product Reference

> Fitbit Air (`ARRIIIIIS/google-health-dashboard`) is a free, open-source, local-first macOS desktop health widget built with Tauri 2, Rust, and React 18. Designed as an unobtrusive Liquid Glass overlay (`24px` super-ellipse radius, no Dock icon, no focus stealing), it surfaces Google Health metrics, Fitbit device battery percentage, 7-day trend curves, interactive desktop companions, AI-generated micro-coaching, and smart sedentary alerts.

## 1. Problem Solved & Target Audience

- **Who it is for**: macOS users with Fitbit or Google Health / Google Fit accounts who want ambient, glanceable daily health telemetry on their desktop without keeping a browser tab open or draining battery.
- **Why Fitbit Air**:
  - Unlike web dashboards, Fitbit Air floats natively on the macOS desktop using `NSVisualEffectView` Liquid Glass translucency.
  - Unlike generic timers, its sedentary reminder combines **step deltas** with **macOS HID keyboard/mouse idle and screen-lock detection**, preventing false alerts when away from the desk and freezing animations at zero CPU/GPU power when locked.
  - All OAuth tokens and LLM API keys remain strictly on the user's machine (`~/.google-health-mcp/` and Tauri `app_data_dir`).

## 2. Core Capabilities

1. **Health Telemetry**:
   - Steps with customizable daily goal (`1,000 – 50,000` steps) and goal-completion celebration.
   - Distance (km), calories (kcal), active minutes.
   - Live heart rate, resting heart rate, HRV, SpO₂, respiratory rate, and sleep stage breakdown (Deep / Light / REM / Awake).
2. **Fitbit Battery & Sync Capsule**:
   - Reads `pairedDevices` battery percentage from Google Health API.
   - Displays battery capsule alongside sedentary minutes; highlights amber at `≤25%` and warns if data has not synced for over 2 hours.
3. **7-Day Smooth Glow Trend Chart**:
   - Expanding the steps or heart rate section reveals an inline 7-day SVG glow line chart with bottom opacity fade, dashed lines for weekend/missing-data intervals, and clickable date/weekday labels.
4. **Interactive Desktop Companions**:
   - 4 characters: **Qiuqiu (球球)**, **Nimbo (云宝)**, **Twinkle (亮亮)**, and **Claw (钳钳)**, plus **Shuffle** (rotates every 3 minutes).
   - 30fps mouse cursor gaze tracking (sleeps beyond 320px).
5. **AI Health Micro-Coaching**:
   - Compatible with any OpenAI-format API (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Moonshot Kimi, SiliconFlow, Zhipu GLM, Qwen, or custom endpoints).
   - Generates concise (<30 chars) persona-driven tips with a 6-item deduplication history; falls back to local rule-based tips when offline or unconfigured.
6. **Streamlined Menu Bar & 3-Step Local Setup Wizard**:
   - Menu bar contains only: Companion selector, Settings & Preferences…, Restart, and Quit.
   - Browser-based 3-step setup wizard (`127.0.0.1`) handles Google OAuth 2.0 (`POST /oauth/start` + callback), LLM latency testing, visual companion selection, sedentary schedule (`notify_start_hour`, `notify_end_hour`, `lunch_break_mute`, `workdays_only`, `dnd_follow`), theme (`auto`/`light`/`dark`), language (`zh`/`en`), step goal, launch at login, and opening the local data folder (`POST /api/open-data-dir`).

## 3. Security & Privacy Architecture

- **Local-Only Storage**: Credentials are written to `~/.google-health-mcp/config.json` and Tauri's `app_data_dir/settings.json`.
- **CSRF / Cross-Site Protection**: The local HTTP server generated by Rust creates a random per-process `X-Setup-Token` injected into `setup.html` (`<meta name="setup-token">`) and required on `/api/*` and `/oauth/*` requests.

## 4. Installation & Build

- **End Users (macOS Apple Silicon)**: Download `Fitbit.Air_3.1.0_aarch64.dmg` from `https://github.com/ARRIIIIIS/google-health-dashboard/releases/latest` and drag `Fitbit Air.app` to `/Applications`.
- **Developers**:
  - Requirements: macOS, Rust ≥ 1.88 (`~/.cargo/bin` before Homebrew in `PATH`), Node.js ≥ 20, Python 3.
  - `npm install`
  - `npm run tauri dev` (development)
  - `npm run install:mac` (release build + clean install to `/Applications/Fitbit Air.app`)

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

- **Does Fitbit Air upload my health data to any third-party server?**
  No. Health data is fetched directly from Google Health API to your Mac (`data.json` in `app_data_dir`). Only if you configure an optional LLM API key will anonymized summary context be sent to your chosen OpenAI-compatible endpoint to generate a short tip.
- **Does it drain battery when my Mac is locked or idle?**
  No. Fitbit Air detects macOS screen lock and hidden widget state, freezing companion animations and pausing background polling for zero-power sleep.
- **Which languages are supported?**
  The widget supports Simplified Chinese (`zh`), English (`en`), and Japanese (`ja`); repository documentation is available in English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
